title: Insulin Pump Program Account Terms: Amounts Excluded from a Payment Plan
content:
**Clause.** When an Insulin Pump Program payment plan is fixed, the covered balance follows the program's open requests:

(a) where a hardship application on the program is in received status, the unpaid amount of the posting the most recently received such application names — that posting's amount less the adjustments against it — is taken off the whole program balance;

(b) where no hardship application is in received status and a payment plan on the program is already approved, what the most recently received approved plan covers — its months times its monthly installment — is taken off;

(c) otherwise the whole program balance stands.

The covered balance is never below zero.

| Hardship application in received status | Approved payment plan on the program | Taken off the whole program balance |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | the unpaid amount of the posting the most recently received application names |
| no | yes | the most recently received approved plan's months times its monthly installment |
| no | no | nothing — the whole program balance stands |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- A hardship application in received status names a $180.00 posting against which $30.00 of adjustments are posted; program balance $400.00: $150.00 is taken off, leaving $250.00.
- No hardship application is pending; an approved plan of 4 months at $25.00 is on the program; program balance $90.00: $100.00 is taken off, and the covered balance is zero, never below.
